text.p: These are the leading stories in the Mozambican press on Wednesday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Jorge Sampaio of Portugal will visit Mozambique between April 28 and May 3 on his first state visit to Africa.

- A senior Mozambican law officer who was sacked after releasing 10 men accused of manufacturing mandrax appears in the Supreme Court in Maputo on Wednesday to appeal against his dismissal. Maputo provincial attorney Luis Muthisse claims that the 10 men -- nine Pakistanis and an Indian -- were not the real owners of the drug factory.
